events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde. Still effortlessly cool and fronting The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', released in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! What's your favourite 007 film or iconic Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the inimitable John Cleese. A true giant of British comedy.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game for pop music.
